description: AI crawlers checked against robots.txt. purpose: search/user_fetch (blocking hides the site from AI answers) or training (blocking is a legitimate choice). verified_on is the date the entry was checked against source_url; null means not yet re-verified.

bots.name: OAI-SearchBot
bots.notes: Surfaces sites in ChatGPT search; independent of GPTBot.

bots.name: ChatGPT-User
bots.notes: User-initiated actions; OpenAI notes robots.txt rules may not apply.

bots.name: GPTBot
bots.notes: Content that may be used to train OpenAI foundation models.

bots.name: Claude-SearchBot
bots.notes: Improves search result quality; disabling stops indexing for search.

bots.name: Claude-User
bots.notes: Fetches pages when a Claude user asks a question that needs them.

bots.name: ClaudeBot
bots.notes: Collects web content for model development; disallowing excludes future material from training.

bots.name: PerplexityBot
bots.notes: Surfaces and links sites in Perplexity search; not used for foundation-model training.

bots.name: Perplexity-User
bots.notes: User-initiated fetches; Perplexity says it generally ignores robots.txt.

bots.name: Google-Extended
bots.notes: Standalone robots.txt token (no own user agent). Controls use for Gemini training and grounding; does not affect Google Search inclusion or ranking.

bots.name: Bingbot
bots.notes: Bing's search crawler (also feeds Bing-powered answers). NOT re-verified against the vendor page on 2026-10-12: the page could not be fetched in the build environment.

bots.name: Applebot-Extended
bots.notes: Robots.txt token that opts content out of Apple foundation-model training; it does not crawl by itself. NOT re-verified against the vendor page on 2026-10-12: the page could not be fetched in the build environment.
